conceptual_explanation: Level 5 Countable Accuracy involves nouns that change meaning based on their type (e.g., 'Work' as labor vs 'Works' as art). You must also master compound noun plurals ('Sisters-in-law') and Latin/Greek irregulars ('Criteria', 'Phenomena') which are common in DSE reading and writing tasks.

rule_cards.name: Meaning Shifters
rule_cards.correct: I have much experience in teaching. / I had many exciting experiences in Japan.
rule_cards.incorrect: I have many experiences in teaching. (When referring to general skill)

rule_cards.name: Compound Noun Plurals
rule_cards.formula: Add 's' to the HEAD noun, not the end
rule_cards.correct: My brothers-in-law are coming for dinner.
rule_cards.incorrect: My brother-in-laws are coming for dinner.

rule_cards.name: The Latin/Greek Trap
rule_cards.correct: The criteria for the scholarship are very strict.
rule_cards.incorrect: The criterias for the scholarship are very strict.

rule_cards.name: Zero Plural Nouns
rule_cards.formula: Species, Series, Means = Same form for Singular and Plural
rule_cards.correct: This species of bird is rare. / These species of birds are rare.
rule_cards.incorrect: These specieses of birds are rare.

head_noun_tasks.explanation: 'Phenomena' is the plural of 'phenomenon', so it requires the plural verb 'were'.
In compound nouns like 'passer-by', the plural 's' is added to the head noun 'passer'.
'Means' is a noun that ends in 's' but can be singular or plural. Here it is singular ('any means').
When 'paper' refers to a newspaper, it is countable ('papers'). When it refers to the material, it is uncountable.
'Criteria' is plural; the singular is 'criterion'. Thus, it uses 'have'.

drill_tasks.question: The social ________ of online influencers has grown significantly over the last decade.
drill_tasks.explanation: 'Media' is the plural of 'medium'. While 'media' is often used as a collective singular now, in formal contexts, it is the plural form.

drill_tasks.question: We are studying two different ________ of mammals in this forest.
drill_tasks.explanation: 'Species' is the same in singular and plural.

drill_tasks.question: Most of the ________ at the conference were experts in renewable energy.
The painter's latest ________ are currently on display at the M+ Museum.
drill_tasks.explanation: When referring to artistic creations, 'work' becomes the countable 'works'.

drill_tasks.question: Which ________ should we use to evaluate the success of this project?
drill_tasks.explanation: 'Criteria' (plural) is needed because 'which' implies choosing from a set.

boss_fight.paragraph: The primary criteria for this award is your academic performance. We have seen many interesting phenomenon in your research. Your sisters-in-laws also mentioned that you have a lot of works to do this weekend.

errors.explanation: 'Criteria' is plural and requires 'are'. Alternatively, use 'criterion' if only one exists.
Only the head noun 'sisters' should be pluralized.

success_feedback: Excellent! Your understanding of advanced plural forms and meaning-shifters is truly impressive.
suggested_next_steps: Study nouns that are always plural (e.g., 'Trousers', 'Goods', 'Remains').
